text: There is a breakpoint before the Square function as shown below. When LabVIEW paused execution at that breakpoint, what will happen if you press the (Step Into) button?
options: LabVIEW will highlights the Square function but will not execute it
LabVIEW will open up the block diagram of the Square function to allow you to single step through the code inside the Square function
LabVIEW will execute the Square function and then highlights the next node to be executes as you continue single-step through the VI
LabVIEW will complete the execution of the VI and return to the calling VI (if one exists)
